message.flyingcarpet.confirm_land: Sneak again to get off. The carpet stays here.
message.flyingcarpet.confirm_air: Sneak again to get off. You're in the air, so you'll fall!
hud.flyingcarpet.outcome.hover: Getting off here: carpet floats, you fall
hud.flyingcarpet.outcome.drop_carpet: Getting off here: you fall, carpet drops as an item
hud.flyingcarpet.outcome.drop_cushion: Getting off here: you fall, carpet becomes a cushion
screen.flyingcarpet.title: Flying Carpet Settings
screen.flyingcarpet.server_note: You're on a server: its own settings decide how carpets work there.
screen.flyingcarpet.speed.help: How fast the carpet flies compared to a Happy Ghast. 1.0 is the same speed, 2.0 is twice as fast. Changes are felt right away.
screen.flyingcarpet.show_hud.help: While riding, shows your speed, height and what happens if you get off, in the top-left corner of the screen.
screen.flyingcarpet.confirm_dismount.hel: ON: the first sneak only shows a warning, and you have to sneak again to get off, so you don't fall by accident. OFF: one sneak gets you off straight away.
screen.flyingcarpet.confirm_seconds.help: How long you have to press sneak a second time before the warning goes away. Example: 3 means three seconds.
screen.flyingcarpet.safe_revert.help: ON: if there is solid ground close below you when you get off, the carpet stays where it is so you can ride it again. OFF: getting off always counts as getting off in the air.
screen.flyingcarpet.safe_distance.help: How close the ground must be for getting off to count as landing. Example: 2 means solid ground within two blocks under the carpet.
screen.flyingcarpet.air_dismount.help: What happens to the carpet when you get off with no ground close below. You always fall either way.
screen.flyingcarpet.hits_to_break.help: How many times a carpet must be hit before it breaks. The count starts over if nobody hits it for five seconds. Players in Creative mode always break it in one hit.
screen.flyingcarpet.break_drop.help: What falls out when someone breaks a carpet by hitting it.
screen.flyingcarpet.sneak_pickup.help: ON: hold sneak and right-click a carpet nobody is riding to put it back in your inventory, with nothing lost.
screen.flyingcarpet.color_match.help: ON: the three cushions in the recipe must all be the same color, and the carpet gets that color. OFF: any three cushions work, and the carpet takes the color of the first one.
screen.flyingcarpet.recipe_left.help: An item needed on top of the three cushions, written as its ID, for example minecraft:breeze_rod. Leave it empty to not need anything here.
screen.flyingcarpet.recipe_center.help: An item needed on top of the three cushions, written as its ID, for example minecraft:breeze_rod. Leave it empty to not need anything here.
screen.flyingcarpet.recipe_right.help: An item needed on top of the three cushions, written as its ID, for example minecraft:breeze_rod. Leave it empty to not need anything here.
